20261121-physics-g11-1.material: [H2 Uphando Lwefiziksi (Phambili)] Uhlalutyo lwentshukumo yokuwa simahla enxulumene ne-Amandla, Intshukumo, Nobudlelane. Into iwisiwe kwindawo engenanto phantsi komxhuzulane $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Yintoni isantya $v$ nomgama $h$ owileyo emva ko-$t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Uphando Lwefiziksi (Phambili)] Uhlalutyo lwentshukumo yokuwa simahla enxulumene ne-Amandla, Intshukumo, Nobudlelane. Into iwisiwe kwindawo engenanto phantsi komxhuzulane $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Yintoni isantya $v$ nomgama $h$ owileyo emva ko-$t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Isantya $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Inyathelo 2: Umgama $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Inyathelo 3: Ngoko ke $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ kwaye $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
